stances_toward.note: Adversary, cooling, confidence C, for the same reason as the ELN: on 11 Oct 2026 the president said on X that he had 'directly given the order' for a bombing in Norte de Santander against the Frente 33, the dissident front tied to alias Calarcá, the fourth air strike of his term; results were unconfirmed the next day. The stub covers both the Estado Mayor de Bloques y Frente (Calarcá) and the Estado Mayor Central (Mordisco); only the first is named in the sources read. Bond grievance, our reading. Gap: no source on the Mordisco faction in this pass.

relations_to.summary: On 11 Oct 2026 about 01:00 an air strike ordered personally by the president hit the dissident Frente 33 (alias Calarcá) in Norte de Santander, the fourth of the government's term; the special operations command ran it, early reports spoke of several dead and seized war material, no official tally the next day. Five alleged Frente 33 members, and a minor, had been captured at La Gabarra (Tibú) on 6 Oct.
